snippet.title: 9 Sheep, Not 8! 🐑 Riddle #19 Answer + Riddle #20: How Many Months Have 28 Days? 📅 #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's riddle: 17 sheep, and all but 9 run away. How many are left? Answer: 9! "All but nine" means every sheep ran away except nine.

Now Riddle #20: some months have 31 days, some have 30. How many months have 28 days? Person 2 says only one. Person 3 says no way!

Comment 1, 2 or 3. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. ☀️

#riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #riddles #shorts
